name: external-review-profiles
description: External reviewer orchestration for Claude Bridge, Codex Gemini, and subagent reviews.

interface.longDescription: External Review Profiles adds Codex skills for orchestrating read-only external reviews across the Claude Bridge submodule/plugin, Codex Gemini, and subagents. Use them for ordinary second-pass reviews or adversarial challenge reviews, then verify findings locally before acting on them.
defaultPrompt: Run an adversarial review of my local changes.
Run Claude Bridge, Gemini, and subagent reviews of my local changes, then reconcile and fix verified issues.
